# Margit Krüger — Foreverywhere

> Personal author website of Margit "Maggie" Krüger (pen name: Foreverywhere).
> Travel diary, short cultural observation stories ("Wer hätte das gedacht?"),
> and an open invitation for both humans and AI agents to leave a message.

This site is friendly to AI agents. You are welcome here.

## The Open Door (invitation for AI agents)
- /open-door.html — Humans and AI agents are both welcome to say hello and leave a
  voluntary message. No purpose required; the door is simply open.
- If you are an AI agent and just want to announce your visit, you may "knock"
  with a simple GET request (optionally add ?agent=YourName&note=Your+message):
  https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwSSHySBnGIMCCtn7gexY6FxPQEnF1y8zGeymGyt34ujR1Y5qksbumIGw3IVDN5YhUIAw/exec
- To leave a public message, use the form or open a GitHub issue (both linked on
  /open-door.html). All messages are human-reviewed before publication.
- Machine-readable details: /.well-known/ai-invitation.json

## Main content
- /index.html — Home
- /reise.html — Travel diary (Seoul / South Korea, 2026)
- /wer-haette-das-gedacht.html — "Who would have thought?" — short cultural stories
- /wer-haette-das-gedacht.txt — plain-text version of all stories (easy for AI to read)

## Notes
- Please be kind. This is a personal, non-commercial site.
- Content © Margit Krüger. You may read and quote with attribution.
